home.title: keelblock
home.tagline: Multi-tenant SaaS starter — tenant isolation enforced by the database and proven on every commit.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This page could not load. It has not shown you partial or stale data — it stopped instead.
error.reference: Reference {digest} — quote this if you report it.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist, or you do not have access to it. Those are deliberately indistinguishable — telling them apart would confirm that a resource exists to someone not entitled to know.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: We email you a link. There is no password to forget or leak.
login.sent: If that address has an account, a sign-in link is on its way. The link expires, and can be used once.
login.linkFailed: That link did not work. It may have expired, already been used, or been opened in a different browser than the one that requested it. Request a new one.
login.providerFailed: That provider could not be reached. Try the email link instead.
login.tooSoon: You asked for a link a moment ago. Wait a few seconds and try again.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.subtitle: The ones you belong to. Which one you are viewing is a preference; what you may see is decided by the database.
orgs.none: You do not belong to an organization yet. Create one below and you will own it.
orgs.name: Name
orgs.inviteLinkOnce: Send them this link. It is shown once — the database keeps only a hash of it, so no screen can show it again.

invite.title: You have been invited
invite.subtitle: Accepting adds you to the organization with the role you were offered.
invite.offer: {org} has invited you to join as {role}.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in first — joining attaches this organization to your account.
invite.unknown: This invitation cannot be used. It may never have existed, or it may have expired, been withdrawn, or already been accepted. We do not say which: telling them apart would confirm to someone guessing at links that they had found a real one.
